annotations.title: Check Supabase migrations for RLS and grant gaps

description: Use this when the user wants their Supabase migrations checked for RLS gaps before launch, asks whether the Supabase October 30, 2026 Data API grants change will break their tables, or asks whether a security definer function is callable by anon or by signed-in users. Pass the SQL text: sql for one migration, or files with path and content for several, in the repo's file names. It runs the SQL rules of the VibeRaven 1.6.12 CLI and returns each finding with id, severity, file and line in the text passed, a one-line fix and a guide link. Finding ids: rls_disabled (table without RLS), rls_no_policies (RLS on, no policies), rls_policy_allows_all_read and rls_policy_allows_all_write (using (true) or with check (true) for anon, authenticated or public), security_definer_function_executable (EXECUTE not revoked from anon or authenticated), data_api_grant_without_rls (table granted to anon or authenticated with RLS off), data_api_grant_missing (the browser queries a table that has no grant once default grants are off). data_api_grant_missing needs the migration that revokes default privileges or supabase/config.toml, plus the browser files that call supabase.from(...) (a "use client" file, or src files with package.json for a Vite app). It is a static read of the text passed: it does not connect to the database, does not run the SQL and does not see the rest of the repository. Up to 200 KB in 50 files. The text is processed in memory, not stored and not logged.

files.description: Several files: .sql migrations, and optionally supabase/config.toml, package.json and browser code files.

content.description: The full text of the file.

path.description: The file path in the repo, for example supabase/migrations/20260101000000_init.sql. Migrations run in file name order.

sql.description: The SQL text of one migration file.
